card.name: Digits inside numbers and years
card.fires_on: A digit (mostly 0) or comma in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as the second digit of a year like 2005 or a decimal like 0.058. It is common in dosimetry tables and year ranges.

modes.label: Decimals in dose tables
modes.description: A zero or digit after the decimal point in small values listed in radiation dose tables.

modes.label: Years and ranges
modes.description: The zero after the 2 in a year such as 2005 or 2020, or the end of a range.
modes.example: From 2000 to 2<<0>>05, world population grew by more

modes.label: Comma in thousands
modes.description: The comma inside a number like 1,200 before the remaining digits.
modes.example: A dose adjustment of LIVTENCITY to 1<<,>>200 mg twice daily is recommended

card.plain: It marks a spot partway through a number, where more digits are still to come.
